hooks._comment: Central component guard (MEH-128): warns when editing high-risk files. Warning-only, always exits 0. See docs/CENTRAL_COMPONENTS.md.
Bash safety guard — blocks dangerous DDL and destructive filesystem commands. Exit 2 = block. Fail-open if jq missing.

MEH-422 skill-bypass guard — blocks subprocess invocations that bypass MEH-397 hooks (node tools/, python tools/, bash tools/, tools/clis/, tools/integrations/, tools/REGISTRY). Also blocks direct invocation of known-network skill scripts (audit_a11y.py, check_shabbat.py) when their skill's allowed_network_hosts is null/empty. Exit 2 = block. Fail-closed if jq missing or input malformed.
RTL physical-property guard — blocks physical left-*/right-*/ml-*/mr-* in non-allowlisted files. Exit 2 = block. Fail-open if jq missing.
MEH-397 Layer 1: blocks Read on .env files. Exit 2 = block. Fail-closed if jq missing.
MEH-397 Layer 1: blocks WebFetch outside the supply-chain allowlist (github, anthropic, npmjs, pypi, mehamakor, vercel, railway). Exit 2 = block. Fail-closed if jq missing.

PostToolUse ESLint — lint the single file just edited in frontend/ so undefined-variable regressions (PR #43 class) surface immediately, not at Stop. Skips on non-frontend files, missing node_modules, or missing config. Lint errors exit 2 (blocks the tool call) so Claude sees the failure and fixes it before moving on.
hooks.command: bash -c 'if command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1; then fp=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // \"\""); else fp=$(cat); fi; case "$fp" in *frontend/*.js|*frontend/*.jsx|*frontend/*.ts|*frontend/*.tsx) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; if [ ! -d "$root/frontend/node_modules" ] || [ ! -f "$root/frontend/.eslintrc.json" ]; then exit 0; fi; cd "$root/frontend"; rel="${fp#$root/}"; result=$(npx --no-install eslint "$rel" --max-warnings 0 2>&1); lint_exit=$?; if [ $lint_exit -eq 2 ]; then echo "Warning: ESLint config error on $rel, skipping" >&2; exit 0; fi; if [ $lint_exit -ne 0 ]; then echo "$result" | tail -20 >&2; echo "ESLint errors in $rel — fix before continuing." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'

hooks._comment: Defensive frontend build hook. Mirrors the pytest hook pattern: skip gracefully if node_modules or frontend/ is missing, block ONLY on real build failures.
hooks.command:
bash -c '# Defensive frontend build hook
# Guards:
#   1. frontend/ missing        -> warn + exit 0
#   2. node_modules missing      -> warn + exit 0 (npm install not run)
#   3. build fails for real      -> emit decision:block JSON
#   4. build passes              -> exit 0
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
if [ ! -d "$root/frontend" ]; then
  echo "Warning: frontend/ not found at $root, skipping build"
  exit 0
fi
if [ ! -d "$root/frontend/node_modules" ]; then
  echo "Warning: frontend/node_modules not found, skipping build (run npm install)"
  exit 0
fi
cd "$root/frontend"
set -o pipefail
if ! npm run build 2>&1 | tail -20; then
  echo '"'"'{"decision":"block","reason":"Frontend build failed — fix errors before completing this task"}'"'"'
fi
'

hooks._comment: Defensive ESLint no-undef hook. Catches the class of regression from PR #43 (referencing deleted variables). Distinguishes config errors (exit 2 = warn + skip) from lint errors (exit 1 = block). Skip gracefully if node_modules or config is missing.
hooks.command:
bash -c '# Defensive ESLint hook — catches undefined-variable bugs
# Guards:
#   1. frontend/ missing        -> exit 0
#   2. node_modules missing      -> warn + exit 0
#   3. .eslintrc.json missing    -> warn + exit 0
#   4. ESLint config error (exit 2) -> warn + exit 0 (don'"'"'t block on bad config)
#   5. Lint errors found (exit 1)   -> emit decision:block JSON
#   6. No errors                    -> exit 0
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"
if [ ! -d "$root/frontend" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
if [ ! -d "$root/frontend/node_modules" ]; then
  echo "Warning: frontend/node_modules not found, skipping ESLint"
  exit 0
fi
if [ ! -f "$root/frontend/.eslintrc.json" ]; then
  echo "Warning: .eslintrc.json not found, skipping ESLint"
  exit 0
fi
cd "$root/frontend"
result=$(npx eslint . --max-warnings 0 2>&1)
lint_exit=$?
if [ $lint_exit -eq 2 ]; then
  echo "Warning: ESLint config error, skipping lint check:"
  echo "$result" | tail -10
  exit 0
elif [ $lint_exit -eq 1 ] || [ $lint_exit -gt 2 ]; then
  echo "$result" | tail -30
  echo '"'"'{"decision":"block","reason":"ESLint found errors — fix before completing this task"}'"'"'
fi
'

hooks._comment: Vitest component tests. Blocks on failure. Skips gracefully if vitest not installed or __tests__/ missing.
hooks.command: bash -c 'root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; if [ ! -d "$root/frontend/__tests__" ]; then echo "Warning: frontend/__tests__/ not found, skipping component tests"; exit 0; fi; cd "$root/frontend" && npx vitest run --reporter=verbose 2>&1 | tail -30; test ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -eq 0 || echo '"'"'{"decision":"block","reason":"Vitest component tests failed — fix errors before completing this task"}'"'"''

hooks._comment: Backend pytest. Blocks on real test failures. Graceful skip if pytest not installed or test file missing. Install pytest via: pip install pytest pytest-asyncio httpx -r backend/requirements.txt --break-system-packages
hooks.command: bash -c 'root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; if ! python -m pytest --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "Warning: pytest not available — install via: pip install pytest pytest-asyncio httpx --break-system-packages"; exit 0; fi; if [ ! -d "$root/backend" ]; then echo "Warning: backend/ not found, skipping"; exit 0; fi; if [ ! -f "$root/backend/tests/test_api.py" ]; then echo "Warning: backend/tests/test_api.py not found, skipping backend tests"; exit 0; fi; cd "$root/backend" && python -m pytest tests/test_api.py -q --tb=short 2>&1 | tail -20; test ${PIPESTATUS[0]} -eq 0 || echo '"'"'{"decision":"block","reason":"Backend tests failed — fix errors before completing this task"}'"'"''
